code_label: Quantum loading is fundamental to Monte Carlo
text_span: The quantum algorithm for generating or loading a probability distribution on quantum computers is fundamental in Quantum Monte Carlo.
rationale: States the central problem the paper addresses.

code_label: Distribution loading can erase quantum advantage
text_span: the whole improvement may be lost in cases when the method of distribution loading is ineffective.
rationale: Identifies a key caveat motivating the paper.

code_label: Need for flexible market-model loading
text_span: the technique should be flexible enough to load any of the market models.
rationale: Defines a design requirement for the proposed method.

code_label: Novel effective approach proposed
text_span: I propose a new effective approach to the probability distribution loading for derivative pricing.
rationale: Explicit statement of the paper's main proposal.

code_label: Quantum Binomial Tree as quantum binomial implementation
text_span: The Quantum Binomial Tree is the quantum implementation of the classical Binomial Tree.
rationale: Names and characterizes the proposed algorithm.

code_label: Exponential path growth on quantum computer
text_span: This method allows us to increase the number of Monte Carlo paths exponentially on a quantum computer1.
rationale: Claims the key computational effect of the method.

code_label: Models covered by the method
text_span: I introduce how to load the local volatility model, the Heston model, the SABR model, and how to model any arbitrary multidimensional system of stochastic differential equations to quantum computers.
rationale: Summarizes the scope of model support.

code_label: Detailed implementation and numerical analysis provided
text_span: I also demonstrate the detailed implementation with the source code of option pricing with time-dependent volatility. I also show the numerical results and conduct the complexity analysis.
rationale: States the empirical and analytical components included.

code_label: Quadratic speed-up context
text_span: the whole algorithm has a quadratic speed-up compared to classical Monte Carlo.
rationale: Frames the overall quantum advantage claim.
